article.title: How Sleep Supports Learning
article.content: People often cut sleep to gain extra study time, yet this strategy can backfire. During sleep, the brain processes and organizes what you learned in the day. It strengthens important memories and removes unnecessary information. Without enough rest, attention drops, reaction time slows, and mistakes increase. Experts suggest keeping a regular sleep schedule and reducing screen exposure before bed. Even small changes, such as sleeping thirty minutes earlier, can improve next-day focus and recall.
article.translation: 很多人为了多学习而压缩睡眠，但这种做法常常适得其反。睡眠期间，大脑会整理并加工白天学到的内容，强化重要记忆并清理无用信息。睡眠不足会导致注意力下降、反应变慢、错误增多。专家建议保持规律作息，并在睡前减少屏幕使用。即使只是提前三十分钟入睡，也可能显著提升第二天的专注与回忆能力。

questions.prompt: Why can reducing sleep be a poor study strategy?
options: It gives people less free time
It makes books harder to find
It removes the need for review
It can reduce attention and increase mistakes
questions.explanation: 文章说明睡眠不足会降低注意力、减慢反应并增加错误。

questions.prompt: What does the brain do during sleep according to the article?
questions.explanation: 文中说大脑在睡眠时处理和整理当天所学。

options: Sleep at a different time every night
Go to bed thirty minutes earlier
Replace sleep with longer study sessions
questions.explanation: 末句以提前三十分钟入睡为小改变的例子。
